item.title: Tourists stopped from seeing The Last Supper, while Olympic VIPs including Vance visit
item.description: Tourists to Milan during the Winter Olympics hoping to see Leonardo da Vinci’s “ The Last Supper” were in for an unwelcome surprise: Access to the masterpiece is closed to the public for 3 1/2 days.

item.title: What to know about Catholic Jimmy Lai’s Hong Kong journey from media mogul and activist to convict
item.description: To his supporters, former Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai is a fighter for democracy. To the government, he is a traitor to his motherland.

item.title: Brazil Catholics say agrarian reform is too slow under Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s administration has sent important signals to Brazil’s landless rural workers regarding land reform, but those signals have yet to translate into concrete measures.

item.title: Peru bishop expects papal visit, touts Leo’s vision of synodality
item.description: After the Peruvian bishops’ recent ad limina visit to Rome, one of the church’s shepherds said a papal visit is almost certain and highlighted several top priorities for Pope Leo.

item.title: Caritas Bangladesh calls for global defense of human dignity on Int’l anti-Trafficking Day
item.description: At the central Caritas office in Dhaka, a special program unfolded to mark the day under the theme, “Peace Begins with Dignity: A Global Call to End Human Trafficking.”

item.title: Vatican again OKs Archbishop Fulton Sheen beatification after 2019 ceremony derailed at last minute
item.description: The Vatican has given the green light, again, to beatify Archbishop Fulton Sheen, the popular U.S. radio and TV preacher.

item.title: Abp Lori issues pastoral letter on renewal of U.S. political culture
item.description: Drawing on the writings of Popes Leo XIV, Francis, and Benedict XVI, the pastoral letter offers an unsparing view of the state of U.S. political discourse.

item.title: Senior U.S. Church leaders call for presidential apology in wake of racist social media post
item.description: Cardinal Blase Cupich Archbishop Edward Weisenburger called on Trump to apologize for sharing a racist video meme to his Truth Social account, calling the harm done by his action real and saying his explanations for his behavior are inadequate.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV warns Madrid’s priests that faith can be instrumentalized or relegated amid political uncertainty
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has sent a letter to approximately 1,100 priests from Madrid, warning them that growing polarization and secularization puts the faith at dual risk of being instrumentalized or made irrelevant.

item.title: Pope Leo uses Winter Olympics to define Church’s relationship with sport
item.description: As the world’s attention turns to Italy for the Winter Olympics, Pope Leo XIV took the opportunity to send a letter marking the occasion. He used it to talk about the Church's attitude to all sports.
